execution.overwrites: never unless --overwrite; -o equal to an input is refused

not_provided: face recognition or identifying anyone (a face box is never an identity)
decoding video (frames come from ffmpeg-skill look / scenes)
blurring or redacting (ffmpeg-skill redact, from the tracks rectangles)
downloading model files (a one-time manual step, see README)
network access of any kind at run time
exporting RF-DETR to ONNX (a one-time manual step with the rfdetr package and PyTorch, see README)
cropping or applying a reframe path (video-editing-skill, ffmpeg-skill crop)
cutting between cameras or aligning them by audio (ffmpeg-skill multicam, from the speakers switch list)
speaker diarization (diarization-skill turns, read when given)
deciding or removing personal data on its own (every pii region is a CONFIRM proposal; ffmpeg-skill redact applies the confirmed ones)
named-entity recognition (pii is a keyword and format check)

en-GB.means: an NHS number after its keyword
a UK phone number (0 and 9-10 more digits)

en-US.means: a US social security number after its keyword
a street address (number, name, Street / Ave / Rd ...), optionally with a ZIP code

intl.means: an id after a patient id keyword (Patient ID, MRN, medical record, hospital number, case no.)
a date after a birth keyword (DOB, date of birth, born)
an international phone number (+country code, E.164 style)
a number after a phone keyword (Tel, Phone, Mobile, Fax)
words after a name keyword (Patient:, Name:, Patient name:)
a capitalised name after Mr / Mrs / Ms / Miss / Mx

ja-JP.means: 患者ID / 患者番号 / カルテ番号 / 診察券番号 の後の番号
生年月日 / 誕生日 の後の日付（和暦・西暦）
日本の電話番号（0 から始まる市外局番つき）
〒 郵便番号（とその後の住所）
住所 の後の文字列
氏名 / 患者名 の後の文字列
様 / 殿 の前の氏名

rank.attributes: detection faces --attributes: eyes_open, sharpness, frontal, size

shots.frames: every frame, ffmpeg-skill look --at floor_ms(k / frame_rate)
shots.shot: [start_frame, end_frame] inclusive; start = start_frame / rate, end = (end_frame + 1) / rate

speakers.timeline: camera 0 (reference); reference time = camera time + offset (multicam offsets_seconds)

tools.description: Face boxes (YuNet) at sampled times of a video, or in an image: time, box in pixels and normalized, score, five landmarks, engine, model and model sha256; with --attributes also each face's measured size, pose (yaw, roll, frontal), sharpness, mouth contrast and eyes open (heuristics). A face box is never an identity

Text lines (Tesseract, ja/en, vertical Japanese with jpn_vert) with their boxes and OCR text, from a video's sampled frames or an image (a slide, a screenshot); --engine ppocrv6 reads them with PP-OCRv6 (optional, ONNX, line level) instead
Object boxes (YOLOX, COCO's 80 classes) with class and score, optionally only some classes; --engine rfdetr detects them with RF-DETR Small / Medium (optional, an ONNX export) instead

Link a video's boxes over time by IoU (or centre distance) into track ids and redact-ready rectangles (union per span, padded, even pixels) for ffmpeg-skill redact. A documented heuristic, not identity

Shot boundaries over every frame of a video (frames from ffmpeg-skill look): each shot's start/end in seconds and frames, the boundary kind (cut / gradual), a score and the engine. PySceneDetect (content + adaptive detectors, a blend test for dissolves) by default; TransNetV2 optional

A crop window per sample time for a target aspect (9:16, 1:1, 4:5) from face tracks (object tracks as a fallback), smoothed with a dead zone and a speed limit, switching subject and jumping only at a shot boundary; plus one window per shot. A documented heuristic; it crops nothing

Active speaker for multicam switching: from each camera's face tracks (faces --attributes) and, when given, diarization-skill turns, which face speaks in each time range (mouth motion, or turns matched to faces) and which camera shows it best (size, frontal angle, sharpness), as a switch list for ffmpeg-skill multicam --switch. A documented heuristic; it cuts nothing

Personal and patient data in slides and frames: OCR text lines checked for names, patient ids, dates of birth, phone numbers and addresses (keyword and format patterns per locale: intl by default, en-US, en-GB, ja-JP opt-in) and, when given, faces; each hit a redact-ready rectangle with its category, rule and reason, every one a proposal to confirm (CONFIRM). It removes nothing

Rank a video's sampled frames (or images) for a thumbnail or a take by their faces' measured attributes: eyes open, sharpness (blur), frontal angle and size, each part and the weighted score listed. A documented heuristic; it suggests, a person or thumbnail-skill picks

Validate a detections (detection-skill/detections@1), tracks (detection-skill/tracks@1), shots (detection-skill/shots@1), reframe (detection-skill/reframe@1), speakers (detection-skill/speakers@1), pii (detection-skill/pii@1) or rank (detection-skill/face-rank@1) document
